abilities.description: Always add +1 to any combat rolls when you are brawling in close-quarters. You can always breathe underwater. You must choose which sub-species you are, and always take that bonus:

Aquala – Add +1 to all @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} rolls, and add +1 to all @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.e6ed148eff82c171]{Face Danger} rolls when in cold or wet conditions.

Ualaq – Add +1 to all @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.703964b8d02355b8]{Resupply} when in a wilderness. @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-1) when in brightly-lit conditions without suitable eye protection. Add +1 when you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.13b2d777c6fb719d]{Gather Information} to search out someone in the dark.

Quara – Either always take +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.9f538fabf8998c5b]{Compel} by threatening OR always take +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.e6ed148eff82c171]{Face Danger} using athletics (choose at character creation). You may @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.93d2d69b7e2b85e1]{Lose Momentum} (-2) to reroll any challenge die when tracking through natural environments.
